physics-h1-q1.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.

physics-h1-q2.title: Rong endhog kanthi massa
physics-h1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q2.material: Rong endhog kanthi massa padha dibuwang saka dhuwur sing padha, siji ing lantai semen lan siji ing bantal sing empuk. Perbandingan besaran fisika wiwit endhog kenek lantai nganti mandheg, endi sing bener?
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.prompt: Rong endhog kanthi massa padha dibuwang saka dhuwur sing padha, siji ing lantai semen lan siji ing bantal sing empuk. Perbandingan besaran fisika wiwit endhog kenek lantai nganti mandheg, endi sing bener?
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.explain: Amarga owah momentum ($\Delta p$) kaloro endhog padha, impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) uga padha. Bantal nambah wektu tumbukan $\Delta t$ lan nyuda gaya impuls rata-rata $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, mula endhog ora pecah.

physics-h1-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-q3.title: Bal baseball kanthi massa
physics-h1-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q3.material: Bal baseball kanthi massa 0,5 kg mabur kanthi kacepetan 30 m/s, banjur kenek pemukul lan mental arah kosok balen kanthi kacepetan 40 m/s. Pira gedhene impuls sing ditampa bal baseball?

physics-h1-q3.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-c.material: [Mekanika lanjutan] Benda massa 1 kg ditembakake kanthi kacepetan 20 m/s arah horizontal saka pucuk jurang kanthi dhuwur 80 m. Pira jarak horizontal sing dilewati benda iki nganti tekan lemah? (Ketentuan: g = 10 m/s², hambatan hawa diabaikan)

physics-killer-10.title: Ing eksperimen efek fotolistrik
physics-killer-10.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-10.material: Ing eksperimen efek fotolistrik kanthi cahya monokromatis ing piring logam, energi kinetik maksimum fotoelektron sing diukur kanggo rong frekuensi yaiku kaya tabel iki. Nalika frekuensi $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$, nalika frekuensi $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$. Konstanta Planck yaiku $h=4.0\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{eV\cdot s}$ (nilai perkiraan kanggo soal). Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake frekuensi ambang $\nu_0$ logam iki lan voltase penghenti $V_0$ nalika cahya kanthi frekuensi $12.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ disorotake?
